description.text: Turn other Floor 7 drops into Fortnite Gizmos and Enchanted Books into Sprites.

Implosion -> Golden Firework, Shadow Warp -> Portable Extractor, Wither Shield -> Extraction Site Booster, Auto Recomb -> Lucky Locator, Precursor Gear -> Sprite Locator, Wither Catalyst -> Sprite Dust.
Also rename those Floor 7 drops to their matching Fortnite Gizmo names.

Turns Floor 7 & Dungeon Enchanted Books (One For All, Soul Eater, Feather Falling, Rejuvenate, Bank, Ultimate Wise, Wisdom, Ultimate Jerry, Legion, Swarm, Combo, etc.) into matching official Fortnite Sprites.
